reference.title: Scenario 6 — List inside a table cell

section.p: Consider a table where the author has placed a bulleted or numbered list inside one of the cells.

row.entry: [Header Row]: Step | Actions [Row]: 1 | [List Bullet]: Download the package [List Bullet]: Verify the checksum [List Bullet]: Extract the archive

entry.codeblock:
Installation Actions Step Actions 1
  • Download the package.
  • Verify the checksum.
  • Extract the archive.

section.p: Result:The converter preserves the list inside table cells and maps to the <ul> or <ol>.
section.note: Use lists inside table cells only when the list represents multiple related values for the same row. Avoid using lists inside tables for procedural steps; if the content is procedural, consider converting it to a DITA task with <steps>.
